LanguageData.CC_R4K_Carve_Done: {X_nameDef} of the {NAME} has finished the carving of {A_nameDef}, and set it out at the edge of their camp for the colony to fetch.
LanguageData.CC_R4K_Carve_Refund: {A_nameDef} never sat down with the {NAME}, so they are sending the {COUNT} silver back to the gate.
LanguageData.CC_R4K_Carve_Busy: Someone of the colony is already sitting for a carving.
LanguageData.CC_R4K_Carve_Impact: {0} walks to their fire and sits an hour while one of them carves; the carving is set out at the edge of their camp
LanguageData.CC_R4K_Carve_Sold: {X_nameDef} of the {NAME} has set out one of their carvings at the edge of their camp for the colony to fetch.
LanguageData.CC_R4K_Fire_Running: A fire is burning {THING}, and two of the {NAME} are running out to beat it out.
LanguageData.CC_R4K_Fire_Out: The {NAME} have beaten out the fire and are walking back to their camp.
LanguageData.CC_R4K_Fire_BreakDone: The {NAME} have finished the firebreak round the {THING}: {COUNT} plants cut down to the ground.
LanguageData.CC_R4K_Fire_Busy: They are already cutting a firebreak.
LanguageData.CC_R4K_Fire_NoField: There is no field with dry grass round it to cut.
LanguageData.CC_R4K_Fire_BreakImpact: Two of them cut the dry grass and bushes in a strip outside the {0} over their working hours, up to {1} plants; never a tree or a crop
LanguageData.CC_R4K_Snow_Together: {A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef} of the {NAME} have finished a snow figure together, and it is standing by their camp.
LanguageData.CC_R4K_Snow_Busy: Someone of the colony is already making a figure with them.
LanguageData.CC_R4K_Snow_Impact: {0} walks to their camp and works an hour with them; the figure stands by their camp until the thaw
LanguageData.CC_R4K_Music_Sold: {X_nameDef} of the {NAME} has packed the new {THING} and set it out at the edge of their camp for the colony to fetch and set up.
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Crows_Gone: The {0} have already left the field.
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Crows_Marked: The {0} nearest of the {1} have been marked for the colony's hunters.
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Crows_Scared: One of the {0} has been shot, and the rest have flown off the colony's land. They pulled up {1} seedlings in all.
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Crows_Watched: The {0} have been chased off the field and are leaving the colony's land. They pulled up {1} seedlings in all.
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Crows_Left: The {0} have had their fill and are leaving the field. They pulled up {1} seedlings in all.
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Impact_CrowsWatch: {0} goes about the {1} until evening and chases the {2} off; nothing more is pulled up while {0} is there
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Impact_CrowsShoot: The {0} nearest of the {1} marked for the colony's hunters; once one is down, the rest leave
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Impact_CrowsLet: The {0} peck about the field until evening and then go; up to {1} seedlings are lost
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Melt_OnlyDoor: It is the only way into the room.
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Melt_Shut: The {0} is shut until the meltwater stops. The colony uses its other doors.
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Melt_Stopped: The meltwater has stopped coming into the {ROOM}.
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Impact_Melt_mop: The water keeps coming into the {0}, and two of the colony mop it up as it comes
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Impact_Melt_shut: The door is kept shut until the meltwater stops, and no more water comes into the {0}
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Impact_Melt_leave: The water keeps coming into the {0} until it stops, and the puddles stay for the cleaners
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Impact_MidgesIn: For {1} evenings, those working by the wet ground near the {0} walk in before dusk
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Impact_MidgesBear: For {1} evenings, those out by the wet ground near the {0} at dusk are bitten and in a bad mood
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Impact_MidgesRisk: Someone bitten may come down with insect bites
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Midges_Bitten: {PAWN_nameDef} was bitten all over by the midges at dusk and has {ILLNESS}.
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Shore_Gone: Nothing is left lying on the shore.
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Shore_Taken: The waves have taken back what was left lying on the shore: {0} heaps.
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Impact_ShoreSea: Everything is left lying on the shore, and the sea takes it back tonight
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Impact_ShoreNear: Only the {0} heaps nearest the colony of the {1} are carried in; the rest goes back to the sea tonight
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Impact_IcePaths: {0} walks from door to door scattering ash on the ice outside all {1} of them; nobody slips while the ice lasts
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Impact_IceDoors: {0} scatters ash outside the {1} doors nearest the middle of the colony
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Impact_IceRiskSome: Away from those doors, someone walking on the ice may slip and sprain an ankle
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Impact_IceRisk: Until it thaws, someone walking out on the colony's ground may slip and sprain an ankle
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Ice_Gritted: {PAWN_nameDef} has scattered ash on the ice outside all {1} doors. Nobody should slip there now.
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Ice_GrittedDoors: {PAWN_nameDef} has scattered ash on the ice outside the {1} doors nearest the middle of the colony.
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Ice_Slipped: {PAWN_nameDef} slipped on the ice outside and has {ILLNESS}.
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Ice_Thawed: The ice on the colony's paths has gone.
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Tree_NoRoom: There is no room for a seat beside the trunk.
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Tree_Marked: The {0} by the colony's buildings has been marked for cutting.
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Tree_SeatMarked: A {0} has been marked under the {1} for the builders.
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Impact_TreeFell: The {0} is marked for cutting and a work party fells it
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Impact_TreeSeat: A {1} is marked under the {0} beside its trunk, and the builders make it
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Stones_Gone: The stones are no longer in the field.
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Stones_NoBench: The colony has no bench that cuts this stone into blocks.
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Stones_Bill: A bill has been set at the {2}: {1}, {0} times.
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Impact_StonesCarry: The {0} stones are carried off the field by a work party
LanguageData.CC_R4E_Impact_StonesBlocks: A bill at the {2} for {1}, {0} times, from the stones in the field
